An ancient [[Voss (species)|Voss]] '''carving''' was shattered by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] and spread throughout the [[Gormak Lands]], a region that was once a Voss holy ground. It was reassembled at the [[Halls of the Righteous]] by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].
